steps: Two instances of one object independently select non-loop and loop clips. Different paused positions are visible together in actual canvas pixels; selecting either instance preserves both frames, clips and local times.

Stopping the selected instance restores only its saved static position while the other paused frame remains visible and layout stays locked. Stop All restores exact static canvas pixels and enables layout editing.
Real requestAnimationFrame playback completes the first non-loop clip while the second instance wraps and keeps playing its own loop. Pausing the selected loop leaves the finished frame intact.

Chinese, English and Japanese controls and instance summaries fit 390px. Changing language preserves the selected instance, both paused frames and exact local times, and the same focused timeline node.
The background visibility handler pauses active instance clocks at the last painted frame without changing their selected clips or positions.

Hiding the preview and replacing its captured snapshot reset instance state. Explicitly replaying cancelled old animation callbacks cannot reactivate a hidden view or modify the fresh static instance session.
